name: vibly
description: Root scripts for the Vibly Expo app and backend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,expo -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.android: concurrently -n backend,android -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run android --prefix frontend"
scripts.ios: concurrently -n backend,ios -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run ios --prefix frontend"
scripts.web: concurrently -n backend,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run web --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
